name: Headline arrives
retired: Not dealt as a moment: its look (the headline words rising out of masks, 38 ms apart) is one of the hero entrances dealt from the deck (motion.md, The hero's entrance); a moment that also moves the headline would be a second entrance.
look: The hero headline's words rise once out of their masks, 38 ms apart, and settle; the sub-line and the buttons fade up behind them.
reduced: The headline stands as written; nothing moves.
phone: The headline or button stands as written.
